items.title: ethresear.ch：ERC-8403，账户作为一个哈希，以及后量子密钥
items.note: 11:24（AnkushinDaniil）。账户只存一个 32 字节根；每个授权（签名密钥，或花费上限、解锁时间这类规则）是一片叶子，`leaf = keccak256(authority_id || predicate)`。交易携带两样东西：证明该叶子在账户根下的成员证明，以及该叶子持有者批准了本交易的见证。文章随后讨论在 EIP-8288 之上换成后量子密钥会是什么样。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: ERC-8403, an account as one hash, and post-quantum keys
items.note_en: 11:24 (AnkushinDaniil). The account stores one 32-byte root. Each authority (a signing key, or a rule such as a spend limit or an unlock time) is a leaf, `leaf = keccak256(authority_id || predicate)`. A transaction carries a membership proof that the leaf is under the account's root, and a witness that the leaf's holder approved the transaction. The post then asks what the account looks like with post-quantum keys on top of EIP-8288.

summary_en: A Sunday. On ethresear.ch, AnkushinDaniil introduced ERC-8403, where an account stores only one root hash and keys and rules are leaves, and discussed post-quantum keys on top of EIP-8288. EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM) closed spec gaps found while writing tests and was assigned opcode 0xA7. Starknet's unified privacy pool passed $2 million shielded.
